name: Tor
lines: Tor: Best thing a door can say.
Kael: You won't see it again.
Tor: I'll see her carrying the wash through it. That's enough.

relationship_event.text: Kael helped Tor fit a household hinge and shared a quiet moment about useful work.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: Elna carried the wash through without putting the basket down. Our hinge did its work.
